title: Reverse entry
purpose: Cancel a consumption or adjustment in the amount ledger by adding an opposite entry.

sections.title: Who can use it and when
paragraphs: Only admin and manager can use this form; a technician or viewer is refused.

When the action is not possible right now, the form opens with a Not available notice giving the reason, its fields are disabled and there is no submit button; Cancel returns to the record. The checks are repeated on the server when you save, so a form that opens is not a guarantee.

The top of the form repeats the specimen ID (a link back to the record), status including any active holds, amount on hand and location, so you can confirm you are acting on the right specimen. The location reads Checked out to the person and destination while checked out, Returned, in hand of the person who received it (with where it came back from) after a return from outside the repository, and Distributed: outside the repository while it is away in a shipment.
It is refused for a disposed specimen and for a distributed one: material sent out of the repository in a shipment takes no physical step until its return is recorded.

Only a Consumed or Adjusted entry that has not already been reversed can be reversed. Initial amounts, derivations and disposals cannot; they need a correction review. The form shows the entry being reversed: its kind, change, who and when recorded it, and its reason.

items.label: Reason
items.description: Required, up to 2,000 characters. Kept in the history with the change. Why the entry is being reversed. Do not enter names, record numbers, birth dates, contact details or other text that could identify a donor.

sections.title: Saving and rules
paragraphs: Reverse entry adds a new Reversal entry at the current time that restores the amount; the original stays and is marked Reversed. There is no time field: the reversal is stamped now, and refused if that would fall before the specimen's latest recorded event. A reversal that would make the amount invalid is refused with the reason. Hidden revision numbers are captured when the form opens. If the specimen was changed by someone else meanwhile, the save is refused with “Specimen VP-… changed since you opened it. Reload it, check the current state and try again” (or, for storage changes, “The specimen's storage location changed since you opened this page… Reload it and try again”). Nothing is saved; reopen the form from the specimen record to pick up the current state before entering the action again.
